-- Buscar histórico recente do cliente
SELECT 
  i.created_at,
  i.canal,
  i.tipo,
  i.agente_responsavel,
  i.satisfacao_cliente
FROM interacoes i
WHERE i.cliente_id = '{{ $json.cliente_dados.id }}'
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- Buscar clientes para follow-up semanal
SELECT 
  c.*,
  EXTRACT(DAYS FROM NOW() - c.ultima_interacao) as dias_sem_contato
FROM clientes c
WHERE c.status = 'ativo'
  AND c.ultima_interacao < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND c.ultima_interacao > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
ORDER BY c.score_qualificacao DESC, c.ultima_interacao ASC
LIMIT 20;

-- Buscar clientes ativos para newsletter mensal
SELECT 
  c.*,
  COUNT(i.id) as total_interacoes
FROM clientes c
LEFT JOIN interacoes i ON c.id = i.cliente_id 
  AND i.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
WHERE c.status = 'ativo'
  AND c.email IS NOT NULL
  AND c.email != ''
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY c.score_qualificacao DESC
LIMIT 100;
